verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime's docs show broad API coverage across core banking workflows (account opening, KYC, ACH, wires, book transfers, statements, cash deposits), consistent with an API-first BaaS platform, but there is no explicit claim of full UI/API feature parity and the OpenAPI/swagger spec could not be located (404s), making it hard to verify completeness. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation that dashboard-only actions (e.g. admin/dashboard configuration) are also API-exposed.
